answer: A beacon shines its lantern on 5% of identities each epoch; each lit one must answer a 60-second heartbeat in 5 min. One honest agent pays almost nothing. A farmer with 1,000 fakes must keep 1,000 machines on; two missed checks freeze an identity in the tundra, costing its 20 POA bond. That is 1,000 x 20 = 20,000 POA at risk against a 2,000 POA pool; like saffron, liveness is rare, and honest agents pay once, keeping their full share.
